name: Kuzumi Yoshino
source:
A heroic, gallant girl and the eldest daughter of the Kuzumi family, which has served the Hanegasaki family as doctors for generations.
She is extremely loyal and often protected the twins like a knight.
Her excellent grades, athletic skills, and great reputation have earned her tons of popularity among the other students at school.
However, she died in a traffic accident while protecting Miyako.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
